findings.title: Uncommitted Self-Improvement Cycle Artifacts in Working Directory

evidence.observation: Working tree is dirty due to uncommitted review summaries and run artifacts from self-improvement cycles

proposed_action.description: Update .gitignore to ignore runtime review output and run artifact directories or implement automated post-cycle cleanup.
